en.answer: The effect of <<11799>> that prevents battle damage can be activated during the Start Step but not during the End Step.
en.question:
Can the effect of <<11799>> that prevents battle damage be activated during the Start Step?

en.title: Can the effect of <<11799>> that prevents battle damage be activated during the Start Step?  Also, can it be activated during the End Step?
